alt: Review Exercise 3 · Q5: Use Venn diagrams to verify the following: (i) A − B = A ∩ B′ (ii) (A − B)′ ∩ B = B > ⚠ Note on the printed question: the scan shows "A − B = A ∪ B′" for (i). That is a misprint, because A ∪ B′ is not equal to A − B in general (for example A ∪ B′ contains everything outside B, but A − B does not). The correct identity is A − B = A ∩ B′, and this is the one verified below.

steps.title: Part (i)
steps.text: \[\begin{aligned}&\text{(i) }A-B=A\cap B'\\[5pt]&\quad \text{Draw two overlapping circles A and B}\\[5pt]&\quad \text{in U.}\\[5pt]&\quad \text{Left side }A-B:\text{ shade the part of}\\[5pt]&\quad \text{circle A that is }\textcolor{#047857}{\textbf{outside}}\text{ circle B}\\[5pt]&\quad \text{(the crescent of A).}\\[5pt]&\quad \text{Right side }A\cap B':B'\text{ is everything}\\[5pt]&\quad \text{outside circle B; }A\cap B'\text{ is the part}\\[5pt]&\quad \text{of A that lies in }B',\text{ i.e. again the}\\[5pt]&\quad \text{part of circle A outside circle B.}\\[5pt]&\quad \text{Both diagrams show the same shaded}\\[5pt]&\quad \text{crescent }\Rightarrow \text{ }\textcolor{#047857}{\mathbf{A-B=A\cap B'}}\text{ $\;\checkmark$}\end{aligned}\]

steps.title: Part (ii)
steps.text: \[\begin{aligned}&\text{(ii) (A }-B)'\cap B=B\\[5pt]&\quad A-B\text{ is the crescent of A outside B,}\\[5pt]&\quad \text{so (A }-B)'\text{ is the whole rectangle}\\[5pt]&\quad \text{except that crescent. It includes the}\\[5pt]&\quad \text{whole of circle B.}\\[5pt]&\quad \text{Intersecting with B keeps only circle}\\[5pt]&\quad \text{B, which lies entirely inside}\\[5pt]&\quad \text{(A }-B)'.\\[5pt]&\quad \therefore \text{ (A }-B)'\cap B=B\text{ $\;\checkmark$}\\[5pt]&\quad \text{Algebraic check: (A }-B)'=\text{ (A }\cap B')'\\[5pt]&\quad =A'\cup B,\text{ and }(A'\cup \text{ B) }\cap B=B.\end{aligned}\]
